title: Randomized-controlled PMCF study of the efficacy of the use of MBST magnetic resonance therapy
summary:
Study design: randomized-controlled, double-blind.
The study population includes a total of 114 patients (57 per arm). Eligible study participants are men and women over 18 years of age, following implantation of total knee arthroplasty for gonarthrosis. Patients will be assigned (randomized) to treatment arm and control arm at inclusion. Patients in the treatment arm will receive 9 treatments with the MBST device in addition to standard therapy. The control group will receive only standard post-treatment therapy after knee replacement. The MBST magnetic resonance therapy device consists of a movable applicator unit with control unit and display for device operation and the patient couch. Pulsed electromagnetic fields are generated in the ARTHRO-SPIN-FLEX therapy device. The biophysical effect of electromagnetic radio impulses is the induction of electrical tissue currents, which lead to metabolic stimulation in the tissue. The MBST therapy device uses pulse frequencies up to a maximum of 18 kHz and is therefore considered harmless to humans. 
The purpose of this PMCF study is to confirm the safety and performance of MBST magnetic resonance therapy after knee replacement and additionally collect data on the efficacy of MBST therapy over a follow-up duration of 12 months.
Scheduled Patient Visits: Visit 1 (screening of the patient, pre-operative pre-treatment interview with education about the study and obtaining written informed consent for study participation).
After implantation, patients are in inpatient stay for 7 days (within this time, the 9 MBST treatments take place).
During the inpatient stay, data are collected on day 2 (Visit 2) and day 6 (Visit 3).
Further visits are scheduled after 6 weeks (Visit 4), 3 months (Visit 5), 6 months (Visit 6) and 12 months (Visit 7).
Duration per patient: 12 months.
conditions: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system and connective tissue
Injury, poisoning and certain other consequences of external causes

interventions.name:
Arm 1- Standard therapy + Intervention;

Patients in this arm receive 9 units of MBST therapy during their 7-day inpatient stay (following endoprosthesis implantation). One unit of MBST therapy has a duration of 60 minutes.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patient is at least 18 years old
- Patient is scheduled for implantation of a total knee joint endoprosthesis
- Patient is able to understand the nature, meaning and significance of his decision to participate in this study to recognize
- Patient has given informed consent for
study participation and data processing according to
DSGVO signed
- Compliance with the instructions for use of the MBST® ARTHRO-SPIN-FLEX
Exclusion criteria:
Implanted infusion, pain and insulin pumps; 
Cochlear implants and other implanted neurostimulators.
